attributes.name: Karivek Vekker
attributes.powers:
Karivek is immune to the Cold, Mental, and Poison traits.

If the check to defeat does not have the Magic trait, Karivek is undefeated.

If undefeated, Karivek does not deal damage. Instead, each character at this location buries 1d4-1 cards of her choice from her hand.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
